text:
Leo (AE): dropping the redline from Kelvin Analytics. procurement pushed back on net30, asking net45 and a PO-before-counter-sign requirement. also want explicit test-data deletion clause in the orderform. attaching redline.
Tess - Legal: noted. quick Q: are they asking for HSM attestation or just key-control language? and which Redwood entity will sign?
Leo (AE): they asked for HSM attestation language in the MSA and prefer Redwood US to sign. they handle anonymized PII, not PHI.
Ibrahim (SE): technical note: Hosted supports CMK (customer-managed keys) but HSM attestation is only available on Dedicated with HSM-backed KMS. For Hosted we can provide our standard KMS handling attestation (procedural).
Zane (Presales): we can present a Hosted vs Dedicated tradeoff for the POC: Dedicated gives the HSM attestation and tighter p95 latency. Hosted is cheaper and quicker.
Karla (Finance): net45 is OK for enterprise POC if we have a PO and billing contact prior to countersign. need AP name for invoice and billing email.
Tess - Legal: redline hotspots: (1) SLA: they want 99.99% & p95 latency <120ms for inference during POC (2) KMS warranty/indemnity (3) subprocessor disclosure for embeddings vendor. need vendor list and data flow diagram.
Leo (AE): their latency ask looks aggressive. their expected qps is ~20.
Ibrahim (SE): p95 <120ms at that qps isn't realistic on Hosted for large models. Our benchmarks show Hosted p95 ~220-300ms depending on prompt size. Dedicated with optimized kernels can reach ~110-140ms. Suggest compromise: commit to a latency SLO and offer a Dedicated addendum for firm p95 SLA. include automatic fallback routing if latency degrades.
Tess - Legal: propose language: "Provider will use commercially reasonable efforts to meet latency SLOs. Firm p95 latency SLAs may be provided via a Dedicated deployment addendum which will specify remedies." ok?
Zane (Presales): will prepare a one-pager comparing expected latencies & cost for Hosted vs Dedicated and include Dedicated trial pricing. ETA: today EOD.
Karla (Finance): note: if they insist on net45 but want invoice after first month, we need clear milestone in orderform. also need PO number before countersign.
Tess - Legal: signature flow request?
Leo (AE): procurement wants flow: Procurement -> Legal (Customer) -> CFO sign -> Redwood Exec. they asked for countersign within 48 business hours.
Karla (Finance): 48 business hours is tight; finance can expedite if PO and billing contact come in advance. we can e-sign via DocuSign.
Tess - Legal: flag: any ARR or committed spend >$200k needs VP commercial + legal head signoff.
SigBot: ACTIONS CREATED:
- Tess to draft MSA response with Dedicated addendum fallback and KMS attestation language (ETA 1 business day).
- Ibrahim to attach perf matrix and Dedicated trial cost estimate (ETA EOD).
- Leo to obtain PO, billing contact, and signer names from Kelvin procurement (ETA today).
- Karla to confirm invoice flow and note net45 terms on orderform (ETA EOD).
Zane (Presales): pinging Kelvin to offer Dedicated trial and collect their vendor list for subprocessors.
Leo (AE): pinged them — procurement replied asking for our vendor list and a sample DPA. shared link to redwood.com/dpa.
Tess - Legal: I'll prepare vendor list template and DPA excerpt. if they insist on HSM cert on Hosted, we'll escalate to Product Security.
Ibrahim (SE): sample order snippet: 
```
OrderForm:
  Customer: Kelvin Analytics
  POC term: 90 days
  Billing: Net45 (PO required pre-countersign)
  Deployment: Hosted default; Dedicated via addendum
  KMS: CMK on Hosted (procedural attestation) or HSM on Dedicated (hardware attestation)
  SLA: latency SLO; firm p95 SLA requires Dedicated addendum
  Data: test-data deletion clause to be included; subprocessor list attached
  Sign flow: Procurement -> Customer Legal -> Customer CFO -> Redwood Exec
```
Leo (AE): please react with :thumbsup: if you agree on the plan.
Tess - Legal: :thumbsup:
Ibrahim (SE): :thumbsup:
Karla (Finance): :thumbsup:
Zane (Presales): :thumbsup:
Leo (AE): thanks team — I'll post updates when PO and signer list are in.
